essentials.title: Essentials
essentials.copy: Copy the selected item to the Clipboard
essentials.paste: Paste the contents of the Clipboard

windows.title: Windows
windows.appExpose: Show all windows of the front app
windows.minimize: Minimize the front window to the Dock
windows.minimizeAll: Minimize all windows of the front app
windows.closeAll: Close all windows of the app
windows.fullScreen: Use the app in full screen
windows.nextWindow: Switch to the next window of the app
windows.previousWindow: Switch to the previous window of the app
windows.switchApp: Switch to the most recently used app

search.title: Find
search.findNextHint: Find the next occurrence of the item found before

finder.title: Finder
finder.newFolderWithSelection: Create a new folder with the selection
finder.moveHere: Move the files in the Clipboard here
finder.slideshow: Show a slideshow of the selection

finderNavigation.title: Finder navigation
finderNavigation.enclosingFolderInNewWindow: Open the enclosing folder in a new window

finderView.title: Finder view
finderView.togglePathBar: Show or hide the path bar
finderView.toggleStatusBar: Show or hide the status bar
finderView.toggleTabBar: Show or hide the tab bar

textNavigation.title: Moving through text
textNavigation.documentStart: Go to the beginning of the document
textNavigation.documentEnd: Go to the end of the document
textNavigation.lineStart: Go to the beginning of the line
textNavigation.lineEnd: Go to the end of the line
textNavigation.previousWord: Go to the beginning of the previous word
textNavigation.nextWord: Go to the end of the next word
textNavigation.deleteWordLeft: Delete the word to the left

textSelection.title: Selecting text
textSelection.toDocumentStart: Select to the beginning of the document
textSelection.toDocumentEnd: Select to the end of the document
textSelection.toLineStart: Select to the beginning of the line
textSelection.toLineEnd: Select to the end of the line
textSelection.toParagraphStart: Select to the beginning of the paragraph
textSelection.toParagraphEnd: Select to the end of the paragraph
textSelection.toWordStart: Select to the beginning of the word
textSelection.toWordEnd: Select to the end of the word

textEmacs.title: Editing text (Emacs)
textEmacs.lineStart: Go to the beginning of the line
textEmacs.lineEnd: Go to the end of the line
textEmacs.centerCursor: Center the cursor in the visible area
textEmacs.deleteLeft: Delete the character to the left
textEmacs.deleteRight: Delete the character to the right
textEmacs.killToParagraphEnd: Cut to the end of the paragraph
textEmacs.yankHint: Inserts what was cut with Ctrl-K
textEmacs.openLine: Insert a new line after the insertion point
textEmacs.transpose: Swap the characters before and after the insertion point

textFormatting.title: Formatting text
textFormatting.pasteAndMatchStyleHint: Takes the style of the surrounding content
textFormatting.lookUpDefinition: Look up the definition of the word

keyboardFocus.title: Keyboard focus
keyboardFocus.menuBar: Move focus to the menu bar
keyboardFocus.activeWindow: Move focus to the active or next window
keyboardFocus.toolbar: Move focus to the window toolbar
keyboardFocus.floatingWindow: Move focus to the floating window
keyboardFocus.previousPanel: Move focus to the previous panel
keyboardFocus.toggleTabNavigation: Turn keyboard navigation on or off
keyboardFocus.toggleTabNavigationHint: All controls, or only text boxes and lists
keyboardFocus.statusMenu: Move focus to the status menus
keyboardFocus.windowSidebar: Move focus to the window's sidebar
keyboardFocus.nextControl: Move from a text field to the next control
keyboardFocus.previousControlGroup: Move to the previous group of controls

miscellaneous.title: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.spotlightInFinder: Spotlight search in a Finder window
miscellaneous.toggleInspector: Show or hide the Inspector window
